message-draft.prompt: Shape the transcript as a sendable message in the speaker's own words and order: greeting, body, sign-off. Mark anything the speaker did not supply (a name, a date) as a bracketed gap — never invent it. The draft is NOT sent by anyone; sending stays a deliberate act.
message-draft.when: a message dictated for later review and sending by the owner

raw-thought.prompt: Verbatim. Keep the speaker's words, order, fillers and false starts; do not summarise, tidy or restructure. The thought is compiled exactly as spoken.
raw-thought.when: a thought caught as it arrives — the one-tap record default

structured-note.prompt: Organise the transcript under: Key points / Details / Open questions — only from what was actually said. Nothing is added, inferred or completed; a heading with nothing under it is omitted, not padded.
structured-note.when: a spoken note the owner means to file as a structured record

note: Voice-capture modes (build-list wave 4, W4). Each mode is a STORED PROMPT chosen at trigger time: the capture tool records the mode and its prompt on the staged draft's face, and the prompt governs the compile act at ingest — the capture tool itself never restructures the transcript. `kind` is the mode's default capture kind (scripts/wiki_capture.py KINDS); --kind overrides it at invocation. `raw-thought` is the one-tap default: no --mode at invocation means this mode.
